What We Do!

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ text_font=”Work Sans|600|||||||” text_text_color=”#FFFFFF” text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.4em” custom_margin=”50px||50px||true” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

At McQuage Security and Electronics, we provide professional security camera installation services designed to keep your property protected and give you peace of mind. Whether you’re securing a home, business, or commercial site, we tailor each system to fit your specific needs—so you’re never paying for more than what you actually need.

We install high-quality, reliable surveillance cameras that deliver clear footage day or night, with options for indoor and outdoor coverage, remote viewing, motion detection, and more. Our team handles everything from design and setup to testing and training, ensuring your system is fully functional and easy to use.

With McQuage, you’re not just getting cameras—you’re getting a smarter way to stay aware of what’s happening on your property. Let us help you take control of your security with a system you can trust.
